# Camp Resource: Water Boiler

Keep hot boiled water conveniently at your fingertips with this Water Boiler.

Generates boiled water.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter. Also comes with a static version that can be placed in shelters.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Water Boiler__

**Produces**

Boiled Water

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Water

**Holds**

10 Boiled Water

**Obtainable via**

Season 16 Scoreboard - Rip Daring - 45 tickets

Gold Bullion - Mortimer - Cautious - 1250 Bullion

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

#### **Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units
